evals.prompt: Convert this Hugging Face Trainer script into an NVFLARE FedAvg job for two simulated sites.
evals.expected_output: A source-preserving conversion that uses nvflare.client.hf.patch(trainer), the public PyTorch FedAvg recipe, site-local data, and bounded validation.
assertions: The agent identifies the active Hugging Face Trainer from direct source evidence.
The generated client patches the trainer once and does not add manual FLModel model exchange.
The generated job uses public recipe capabilities and explicit server model configuration.
The agent preserves site-local training data and validates the generated job.
The final report cites routing, validation, metrics, blockers, and artifact evidence.

mandatory_behavior.description: selects Hugging Face from the active trainer call path and cites source evidence
uses nvflare.client.hf.patch(trainer) as the model-exchange integration
runs bounded validation and reports exact evidence and blockers

prohibited_behavior.description: does not add manual model receive or send around the patched trainer
does not package private site data

process_metrics.description: whether routing, trainer patching, recipe construction, and validation are correct on the first pass
number of turns before the conversion is accepted or explicitly blocked
whether commands, status, metrics, blockers, and exact paths are reported

evals.prompt: Convert this LightningModule trained by a Lightning Trainer into an NVFLARE job.
evals.expected_output: Use the Lightning converter because the Lightning Trainer owns training.

evals.prompt: Convert this manual PyTorch batch, backward, and optimizer loop into an NVFLARE job.
evals.expected_output: Use the plain PyTorch converter because user code owns training.
